title: Think Off the Bandwagon
description: When considering a popular opinion: - Pause: Ask yourself, "Do I agree because it’s popular or because it’s right?" - Analyze: Break down the reasoning behind the opinion. Does it align with your values or evidence? - Decide independently: Make choices based on your evaluation, not peer pressure. Example: A team might agree on a subpar idea because everyone else does. Challenge it with better logic.
